subject: prog-cont
title: PROG.CONT.------APP.RDEF.
description: Chart on book p. 388 (JR-10). PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the subject; APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-DOC, TRS (transition) and INFO-DY. From TRS: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: METH. From METH: EXT-F (extended functionalism). From INFO-DY: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). Two further lines, one from the CULT-DOC line and one from the IST-S-ALGN line, end in dots without labels.
